implemented: Search current-page text or drag a region, then create a separate queued output with an explicit semantic or raster mode
Semantic mode removes the encoded target bytes inside one Tj/TJ string and preserves subsequent text advance and vector paths
NFKC search matching handles fullwidth digits; surrounding Chinese text and unselected pages remain available
Full save removes old content streams from the reachable output; document metadata, annotations, forms, attachments and auxiliary catalog content are dropped with an explicit report
Raster mode repaints the whole document and masks the selected region; it is named separately and makes no claim to preserve selectable text
Both modes use durable jobs with retained inputs, cancellation/retry and saved mode/scope reports
